openings.claim: Fresh equivalent prompts plus mutual introduction may reduce entry difficulty caused by unequal familiarity, preserving the valued structure.
openings.discriminator: Earlier reciprocal speech and greater usefulness, especially across familiarity differences.
openings.probe: Randomize consenting pairs against usual prompts; privately record familiarity; introduce for one minute; observe both partners' minutes and usefulness; log preparation.
openings.uncertainty: Proficiency and prompt differences remain alternatives; equivalent prompts must fit coordination time.

openings.claim: A dated paper card may resolve current-versus-earlier task confusion independently of attendance or motivation.
openings.discriminator: Fewer earlier-task answers; count blanks separately.
openings.probe: Compare consenting attendees' private identification of the same task/session across formats; correct misunderstandings and give everyone dated information; log printing, explanation and messages.
openings.uncertainty: Immediate identification may not predict later recall.

openings.claim: Optional independent starters/extensions and alternating speaker roles may improve entry and turn allocation; continuous self-calibration additionally requires a reliable usefulness signal.
openings.discriminator: Both partners gain useful minutes and speaking gaps shrink; balance without usefulness weakens the explanation.
openings.probe: Counterbalance usual/supported rounds using comparable fresh prompts; alternate two six-minute roles, then jointly choose support; observe minutes, collect usefulness/entry slips, log preparation.
openings.uncertainty: Accessible scaffolds, private voluntary support selection and affordable adaptation remain dependencies.

openings.claim: Six dated detachable cards and spare printed packets may restore preparation continuity after absences without tracking learners.
openings.discriminator: Earlier-task errors fall; persistent blanks imply another barrier.
openings.probe: Counterbalance sheet/packet identification; follow six sessions; include creation, printing and replacement effort.
openings.uncertainty: Requires stable topics, self-contained tasks, clear dates and packet retention/replacement.

decision: Historical synthetic proposals, not replication. Preserve free entry despite absence/unpreparedness or declined public proficiency labels; paper access without smartphone/account; conversational practice; one room/75 minutes Wednesday; no paid facilitator additions. Six-session targets: 80% report ten useful minutes, 85% identify next task, coordination below 90 minutes weekly. Useful-practice definitions, attendance reasons and activity costs remain unmeasured; minutes were untimed and slips unlinked.
